scope: Initial source review of remaining audit/refiner/run-all-gates/check-env conversions, batch-two native helpers, and CI deployment/package entrypoints. Existing journal pass is unchanged. No installation, publication, promotion, cleanup or wiki consolidation was executed.

findings.claim: A ticket becomes verified and shippable even when its reported failure was never replayed.
findings.evidence: The missing replay branch prints 'Replay NOT RECORDED; reported failure was not re-executed', then falls through to ticket.status = 'verified'. The ship branch accepts that status without other outcome evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: Require successful replay or an explicit reviewed alternative verification contract; absent that, preserve a partial/approved status and return nonzero.

findings.claim: Consolidation silently corrupts non-UTF8 files despite claiming lossless preservation.
findings.evidence: variants converts every Buffer with data.toString('utf8') at line 26. The other_files branch writes selected.text and history variant.text rather than the original Buffer. Binary payloads outside knowledge/wiki and consolidation are therefore decoded with replacement characters and overwritten during promotion.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve opaque file bytes, or reject unsupported non-UTF8 input before touching destinations. Only redact files explicitly classified as supported text.

findings.claim: Distinct wiki variants from the same source can overwrite one another in preserved history.
findings.evidence: Pages are grouped by basename, including nested pages. History destination uses only source.name and basename(variant.scope). Thus a source containing knowledge/wiki/a/topic.md and knowledge/wiki/b/topic.md with different content writes both variants to the same history file, while the mapping claims both were preserved.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the source-relative path or a content digest in every history destination and reject output collisions before promotion. Add a same-source nested-basename fixture.

findings.claim: Deployment CI path filters omit the newly extracted deployment logic.
findings.evidence: Pull-request and push filters include only deploy/** and deployment workflow files, while the workflow now executes scripts/ci-deployment.mjs authored in runtime/src/ci-deployment.mts. Changes restricted to those implementations do not trigger this workflow.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the new source and emitted entrypoint paths, plus relevant shared runtime dependencies, to deployment CI filters.

checked_classes: Run-all-gates labels skipped slow checks PARTIAL and returns nonzero; static audits explicitly distinguish themselves from build/run proof.
CI profile comparison checks generated bytes and labels execution unverified; no false runtime-certification finding applies there.
CI process execution uses argument arrays; registry/source/digest inputs are validated before publication operations. Review did not execute those operations.
Native helper direct Bash/Python fallback was not found; the Flutter Windows batch launcher is a restricted vendor adapter that rejects expansion characters.
Tauri boot verifier requires a fresh data directory, live process and specific readiness signals, and attempts process-tree cleanup.
This is source review under a weaker same-model fallback, not complete platform execution evidence.
